conformance.command: cargo run --release --features metal --bin vxg -- gpu-check metal

benchmark.command: cargo run --release --features bench,metal --bin vxg-bench -- --file corpus/qualification/json-records-16MiB.ndjson --threads 1 --block-size 65536 --simd neon --gpu metal --samples 5 --seconds 0.2 --csv reports/local-metal-json16-r1.csv --samples-csv reports/local-metal-json16-r1-samples.csv

timestamp_observation.scope: One observation only; not a median and not interchangeable with host end-to-end throughput.

conclusion: Metal is actually executing and conformant on this M2 Max. Its current host-to-end compressor/decompressor is nevertheless slower than the corresponding CPU rows and emits a less compact result on this input. This does not qualify a GPU performance target and cannot substitute for the CPU 4/95/15 acceptance gates.
